body:
Founder real-time: "add a new button to the bottom of the parena
editor to toggle between terminal and editor? unifying pitviper and
the parena editor - have it work just like pitviper where it auto
finds git bash for the terminal". First real, foundational increment
toward that: the backend gap that had to be fixed before any UI
wiring could work at all.

pty-read's own real, documented contract ("reads until the peer side
closes") is correct for test_shell.c's own "run one command, exit"
check, but calling it every frame from the editor's own render loop
against a long-lived, idle interactive shell would freeze the WHOLE
editor the instant the shell sits at its next prompt.

Added pty_poll_read_impl + pty-poll-read: a real poll(2) check with a
zero timeout before ever calling read(), so read() is only reached
when data (or EOF) is actually pending -- can never block. Deliberately
does NOT set O_NONBLOCK on the fd itself (would have silently changed
pty-read's own existing behavior for every caller); pty-read stays
exactly as it was, zero regression.

Added shell/spawn: resolve's own real explicit>$SHELL>Git-Bash>
fallback policy combined with pty-open in one call, matching "auto
finds git bash for the terminal" directly.

10 new real assertions (test_shell.c now 20 total), including a real
wall-clock check proving pty-poll-read returns near-instantly against
a genuinely idle interactive shell (a regression back to blocking
would hang this exact test, not just run slow). Full local suite (336
tests) + test-shell clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 jobs
(Linux, real Windows, real macOS, Tag&Release).

Real, honest scope: backend only. The terminal panel's own UI (toggle
button, render surface, keystroke routing, cwd sharing with the
file-tree sidebar) is real, separate, not-yet-started follow-up.

PARENA commit 83bc177. CI run 33115344246: all 4 jobs green.
